messages.subject: Executive candidate | Thailand and ASEAN corporate affairs, ESG and country leadership
messages.body:
Dear Robert Walters Thailand Team,

I am contacting your Bangkok office directly after the internal bangkokmanagers distribution group rejected external email. I would appreciate your routing my profile to the senior consultant responsible for executive and leadership mandates across industrial, mining, energy, infrastructure and multinational clients.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My 12+ year career spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current responsibilities cover ESG, government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and cross-functional delivery.

My strongest search fit sits across Country Director, Country Representative, Corporate Affairs, External Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, ESG, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and related regional leadership. I bring direct operating experience from a major industrial business, including senior public-sector engagement, community and social-performance governance, stakeholder work around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, and carbon-data readiness.

I am open to Thailand-based, ASEAN and wider APAC expatriate mandates and have a 30-day notice period. My attached CV is tailored to Robert Walters Thailand and I would value a confidential discussion with the appropriate senior consultant.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
